ns2:section.sectionText: This is a self contained 3 credit hour online course. Students registered in this CL course do NOT register for a discussion section. Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through Compas2g. Times and days listed for CL are used to hold exams and optional live problem-solving sessions. All lecture material is pre-recorded as videos for students to watch asynchronously. Students are expected to complete online assignments as outlined in the course syllabus. Synchronous help sessions will be open to all students.
